categories.name: Body Oils

products.name: Kumkumadi Soap
products.shortDescription: Kumkumadi oil, kakadu plum and rose in a creamy goat-milk bar that keeps skin nourished and glowing.
products.description: Our radiance bar. Kumkumadi oil, the classic Ayurvedic glow blend, meets vitamin-rich kakadu plum oil, jojoba and mango butter, with sesame oil infused with rose. Goat milk gives it a soft, creamy lather that cleanses without leaving skin tight.
products.howToUse: Cleanse your face and body twice a day, morning and evening. Work up a lather on damp skin, rinse, then follow with a refreshing mist while your pores are open. Keep the bar on a draining dish between uses.
products.ingredients: Coconut oil, kumkumadi oil, kakadu plum oil, jojoba oil, mango butter, sunflower oil, sesame oil infused with rose oil, goat milk, water, NaOH.

products.name: Dahlia Herbal Face Soap
products.shortDescription: Dahlia oil, gotu kola and aloe vera in a gentle bar for sensitive skin and everyday face care.
products.description: A gentle bar made for your face. Dahlia oil and gotu kola, a herb long used in Ayurveda, join aloe vera juice, kokum butter and grapeseed oil for a soft cleanse that leaves skin feeling refreshed and hydrated, never stripped.
products.howToUse: Cleanse your face and body twice a day, morning and evening. Work up a lather on damp skin, rinse, then follow with a refreshing mist while your pores are open. Keep the bar on a draining dish between uses.
products.ingredients: Coconut oil, grapeseed oil, jojoba oil, kokum butter, gotu kola oil, aloe vera juice, dahlia oil, goat milk, water, NaOH.
products.benefit: Helps keep skin feeling refreshed and hydrated.

products.name: Vanilla Herbal Soap
products.shortDescription: Vanilla, almond oil and shea butter in a cozy bar that nourishes dry skin and leaves it refreshed.
products.description: Comfort in a bar for dry skin days. Almond oil, shea butter and flaxseed oil nourish while you cleanse, aloe vera keeps things calm, and the soft vanilla comes from real vanilla oil, not synthetic fragrance.
products.howToUse: Cleanse your face and body twice a day, morning and evening. Work up a lather on damp skin, rinse, then follow with a refreshing mist while your pores are open. Keep the bar on a draining dish between uses.
products.ingredients: Coconut oil, almond oil, jojoba oil, shea butter, flaxseed oil, sunflower oil, aloe vera juice, vanilla oil, goat milk, water, NaOH.
products.benefit: Helps keep skin feeling soft and hydrated.

products.name: Coffee Cream Soap
products.shortDescription: Real robusta coffee gently exfoliates while cocoa butter keeps skin smooth. Smells like your morning cup.
products.description: Your morning coffee, made for the shower. Sunflower oil infused with robusta coffee powder gently buffs away rough, dull skin, while cocoa butter, tamanu and jojoba oils keep it smooth and supple.
products.howToUse: Lather on damp skin and massage in small circles so the coffee can gently exfoliate, then rinse. Use twice a day on the body, and gently on rough areas.
products.ingredients: Coconut oil, tamanu oil, jojoba oil, cocoa butter, sesame oil, sunflower oil infused with robusta coffee powder, goat milk, water, NaOH.

products.name: Lavender Soap
products.shortDescription: Lavender essential oil, shea butter and olive oil for gentle cleansing and a calm, relaxing scent.
products.description: The wind-down bar. Real lavender essential oil brings a calming aroma to a gentle, creamy lather made with shea butter, olive oil and light watermelon seed oil, leaving skin soft, refreshed and nourished.
products.howToUse: Cleanse your face and body twice a day, morning and evening. Work up a lather on damp skin, rinse, then follow with a refreshing mist while your pores are open. Keep the bar on a draining dish between uses.
products.ingredients: Coconut oil, jojoba oil, watermelon seed oil, sesame oil, sunflower oil, shea butter, olive oil, castor oil, goat milk, gangajal, NaOH, lavender essential oil.

products.name: Sandalwood Herbal Soap
products.shortDescription: Sandalwood oil, pomegranate seed oil and avocado butter. Soothing, gentle and nourishing.
products.description: Warm, woody and soothing. Sandalwood oil, a centuries-old favourite in Ayurvedic care, pairs with pomegranate and papaya seed oils, avocado butter and a hint of vanilla for a gentle bar that helps keep skin soft and healthy.
products.howToUse: Cleanse your face and body twice a day, morning and evening. Work up a lather on damp skin, rinse, then follow with a refreshing mist while your pores are open. Keep the bar on a draining dish between uses.
products.ingredients: Coconut oil, pomegranate seed oil, jojoba oil, avocado butter, papaya seed oil, sesame oil infused with vanilla powder, goat milk, water, NaOH, sandalwood oil.
products.benefit: Soothing; helps maintain soft, healthy skin.

products.name: Aloe Vera Soap
products.shortDescription: Aloe vera gel and tea tree essential oil for a fresh, clean feel. A favourite for men, too.
products.description: Fresh and simple. Aloe vera gel and tea tree essential oil give a clean, cooling feel, while kokum butter and bakuchi seed oil, an Ayurvedic classic, keep skin comfortable. Gentle enough for sensitive skin and loved by men.
products.howToUse: Cleanse your face and body twice a day, morning and evening. Work up a lather on damp skin, rinse, then follow with a refreshing mist while your pores are open. Keep the bar on a draining dish between uses.
products.ingredients: Coconut oil, grapeseed oil, jojoba oil, kokum butter, bakuchi seed oil, aloe vera gel, tea tree essential oil, goat milk, water, NaOH.

products.name: Saffron Sandal Soap
products.shortDescription: Kesar chandan: real saffron strands and sandalwood powder in a rich bar for dry skin, face and body.
products.description: Our Kesar Chandan bar. Real saffron strands and saffron-infused oil meet sandalwood powder, a classic Ayurvedic pairing, with rosehip, carrot seed and jojoba oils and kokum butter for dry skin that needs extra care.
products.howToUse: Cleanse your face and body twice a day, morning and evening. Work up a lather on damp skin, rinse, then follow with a refreshing mist while your pores are open. Keep the bar on a draining dish between uses.
products.ingredients: Coconut oil, rosehip seed oil, jojoba oil, kokum butter, carrot seed oil, sesame oil infused with saffron, saffron strands, sandal powder, goat milk, water, NaOH.

products.name: Haldi Chandan Moisturizer
products.shortDescription: Turmeric and sandalwood with rose water and shea butter. Nourishes deeply and leaves skin soft and glowing.
products.description: Haldi and chandan, the golden duo of Indian skincare, in a rich body and face cream. Shea butter, jojoba and tamanu oils nourish, rose and vetiver hydrosols refresh, and vitamin E and aloe vera keep skin soft and glowing.
products.howToUse: Gently massage onto hands, feet, elbows, knees and other areas prone to dryness. For soft, smooth, itch-free skin, use this body and face cream straight after your bath.
products.ingredients: Jojoba oil, shea butter, tamanu oil, cucumber seed oil, rose hydrosol, vetiver hydrosol, glycerin, aloe vera gel, vitamin E, xanthan gum, beeswax, stearic acid, cetyl alcohol, Olivem 1000 (eco-certified emulsifier), turmeric and sandalwood essential oils.
products.benefit: Deep nourishment and a natural glow.

products.name: Kumkumadi Moisturizer
products.shortDescription: Rose water infused with kumkumadi herbs, plus shea butter and vitamin E. Hydrates and boosts your glow.
products.description: All the radiance of our Kumkumadi ritual in a body and face cream. Rose hydrosol infused with kumkumadi herbs, olive oil and shea butter hydrate deeply, while vitamin E and lily and lotus essential oils leave skin luminous.
products.howToUse: Gently massage onto hands, feet, elbows, knees and other areas prone to dryness. For soft, smooth, itch-free skin, use this body and face cream straight after your bath.
products.ingredients: Olive oil, shea butter, grapeseed oil, rose hydrosol infused with kumkumadi herbs, vetiver hydrosol, glycerin, aloe vera juice, vitamin E, beeswax, cetearyl alcohol, Olivem 1000, Sensicare (eco-certified emulsifier), essential oils of lily and lotus.

products.name: Coffee & Vanilla Moisturizer
products.shortDescription: Hyaluronic acid and niacinamide meet coffee and vanilla essential oils for deep hydration and smooth skin.
products.description: A light, deeply hydrating cream with a cozy coffee and vanilla aroma from essential oils. Mandarin water infused with black tea and tangerine peel, plus hyaluronic acid, niacinamide and aloe vera, leaves skin smooth and supple. 100% vegan.
products.howToUse: Gently massage onto hands, feet, elbows, knees and other areas prone to dryness. For soft, smooth, itch-free skin, use this body and face cream straight after your bath.
products.ingredients: Mandarin hydrosol infused with black tea and tangerine peel powder, xanthan gum, cetearyl alcohol, stearic acid, aloe vera juice, hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, Olivem 1000, Sensicare (eco-certified emulsifier), coffee and vanilla essential oils.
products.benefit: Deep hydration with a smooth texture.

products.name: Herbal Oil
products.shortDescription: A warming herbal massage oil with kalonji, hempseed, camphor and peppermint. Nourishes and refreshes.
products.description: Our warming body and massage oil. Apricot kernel, kalonji and hempseed oils are infused with nettle, spikenard, liquorice, bay leaf and a touch of cayenne, then finished with camphor, peppermint, eucalyptus and cedarwood essential oils for a tingly, refreshing massage. 100% vegan.
products.howToUse: Warm a little between your palms and massage into the body after a bath, or use as a massage oil. It has a warming, cooling tingle from camphor, peppermint and cayenne, so keep it away from your eyes, face and broken skin.
products.ingredients: Apricot kernel oil, kalonji oil, hempseed oil, sunflower oil (infused with nettle, spikenard, liquorice, bay leaf and cayenne pepper), camphor, peppermint, eucalyptus and cedarwood essential oils.
products.benefit: Deeply nourishes and keeps skin refreshed.

products.name: Calming Nourishing Oil
products.shortDescription: Seven light seed oils with bacopa, jatamansi and lavender. Hydrates and strengthens your moisture barrier.
products.description: A calming everyday body oil. Light watermelon, pomegranate and cucumber seed oils absorb easily, sesame oil infused with rosemary, bacopa and jatamansi brings Ayurvedic calm, and geranium and lavender essential oils help you unwind. Great for the scalp too. 100% vegan.
products.howToUse: Apply generously all over straight after a bath, or use as a massage oil. Use it as your everyday lotion, on its own, and massage it into your body and scalp. If you have oily skin, avoid the face.
products.ingredients: Watermelon seed oil, pomegranate seed oil, cucumber seed oil, jojoba oil, grapeseed oil, sesame oil infused with rosemary, bacopa and jatamansi, apricot kernel oil, castor oil, geranium and lavender essential oils.
products.benefit: Hydrates, nourishes and strengthens the skin's natural moisture barrier.

products.name: Mango Butter Lip Balm
products.shortDescription: Mango and shea butter with a fresh grapefruit twist. Keeps lips soft, hydrated and protected.
products.description: Rich mango and shea butters melt into lips to keep them soft and hydrated, with watermelon seed oil for shine and a fresh hint of grapefruit and fennel essential oils. Your everyday save for dry AC air.
products.howToUse: Gently apply to moist lips each morning and before bed. For chapped lips, reapply 3–4 times through the day.
products.ingredients: Mango butter, shea butter, coconut oil, watermelon seed oil, castor oil, beeswax, grapefruit and fennel essential oils.

products.name: Lip Plump Balm
products.shortDescription: Rose petals, licorice and a cool tingle of peppermint for smooth, soft, fuller-looking lips.
products.description: A herbal plumping balm. Coconut oil infused with rose petals and licorice, plus shea butter, smooths and softens, while peppermint essential oil gives a gentle tingle for naturally fuller-looking lips.
products.howToUse: Gently apply to moist lips each morning and before bed. For chapped lips, reapply 3–4 times through the day.
products.ingredients: Coconut oil infused with rose petals and licorice powder, shea butter, castor oil, beeswax, geranium and peppermint essential oils.
